checks.requirement: Explicit solid gold; not plated, vermeil, gold-filled, overlay, or gold-tone
checks.currentEvidence: The captured listings say 14K Yellow Gold but do not explicitly say solid gold or expressly exclude a coating. checks.nextStep: Request written composition details for the exact seller stock number, including whether it is hollow and whether any plating/coating or non-gold core is present. Do not infer from the karat label alone.
